_about: SHELF of Old Norse and Icelandic literature in English before 1931 not held elsewhere: Vigfusson and York Powell's Origines Islandicae (1905) and Corpus Poeticum Boreale (1883), W. C. Green's Egil's Saga (1893), Collingwood and Stefansson's Cormac the Skald (1902) and Sephton's Saga of King Olaf Tryggwason (1895). Morris and Magnusson's Saga Library, Dasent, Laing's Heimskringla, the Poetic Edda and Hollander are on their own shelves. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 88); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. Bare 'green' is left out as a common word.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
